Accept the pre-0.1.0 el_table(data, columns, id) argument order

Source: R/el_table.R
dot-el_table_args.Rd

el_table() used to take data first, which put it out of step with every other component. Positional calls written against the old order land a data.frame in id, so shift them back one slot and warn, rather than letting the data be used as an element id.

Usage

.el_table_args(id, data, columns)

Arguments

id, data, columns

The arguments as received by el_table().

Value

A list with elements id, data and columns.
